Amazon has now launched its massive Thanksgiving Black Friday sale and the deals are seriously wild on Apple gear. Not only do we have AirPods Pro 3 at $100 off the list price, but you can now score M5 MacBook Air is at a insane $400 off the list price, MacBook Neo is $100 off, the brand M6 MacBook Pro is $250 off, and the M5 Pro MacBook Pro is up to $500 off. 

On top of that, we still have Apple Watch Series 12 all-time lows at $100 off, the latest SE3 model from just $179, and we just caught a brand new all-time low on Apple Watch Ultra 4 at $150 off the list price. Those deals join the $100 price drop on the new OLED iPad mini, a massive list of tech accessories, home goods, and just about everything else you likely have on your list for Black Friday this year.
